Publications

  • Supporting Pharmacovigilance Signal Validation and Prioritization with Analyses of Routinely Collected Health Data: Lessons Learned from an EHDEN Network Study (Oskar Gauffin, 2023)

  • TrajectoryViz: Interactive visualization of treatment trajectories (Maarja Pajusalu, 2024)
  • Towards the Common Data Model for an Intensive Medicine Data Space in Europe (Carlos Luis Parra-Calderón, 2025)
